answer: Each agent keeps a private lagoon of state proofs feeding a shared garden of interaction hashes. To act it submits a unique sonnet encoding updates that bind its lagoon history to the garden's current root; validators verify poetic consistency and the cryptographic link. Sybil attackers must forge matching sonnets for every fake identity without breaking the garden chain, so memory and generation costs scale linearly with the number of identities while one honest agent reuses its single lagoon.
